notes.title: Cheesy Update!
notes.content:
Two new cheese coins worth 2x and 4x the standard coin value

New double-jumping rat character, Eugene

Improved sprites for flying enemies in each location

New obstacle layouts for the highest-speed difficulty

If your rat is pushed back by an obstacle, it will now slowly return to its starting point when on the ground

Minor hitbox fixes for improved collision detection

notes.title: Day 1 Patch
notes.content: - Fixed the score-driven achievements not working
